notes.title: Patchnote 9608561
notes.notes:
Hello there! A new micropatch has been uploaded:
[list]
[*]  [FAMILY TREE] Sometimes portraits left their slot once combined and couldn’t be put back.
[*] [ARMOIRE] A mini-game was loaded as complete when it wasn't [spoiler](the sliding puzzle)[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnote 9578798
notes.notes:
We fixed some issues :
[list]
[*] [GLOBAL] Restarting the game during a turning page animation caused a bug
[*] [GLOBAL] The credits in the main menu was outdated
[*] [CLOSET] An object couldn’t be manipulated anymore after reloading the game [spoiler](the picture of S&A)[/spoiler]
[*] [CLOSET] A used object reappeared after reloading the game  [spoiler](the old man locket)[/spoiler]
[*] [CLOSET] The loading of an ongoing minigame sometimes caused an bug [spoiler](the “Destin” game)[/spoiler]
[*] [CLOSET] A portrait was unlocked several times [spoiler](during the “Destin” game)[/spoiler]
[*] [RESEARCH NOTEBOOK] Sometimes, an object couldn’t be used properly [spoiler](the butterfly on the microscope’s slides)[/spoiler]
[*] [WALLET] Switching some objects several times caused a bug [spoiler](the puzzle pieces)[/spoiler]
[*] [WALLET] Opening the family tree while a zoomed object was displayed made it disappear.
[/list]

[u]Note[/u]: this patch may reset your progress in a minigame [spoiler](the “Destin” game in the closet)[/spoiler].

Your feedback helped us make these improvements, thank you!

notes.title: looK INside - Chapter 2 is now available!
notes.notes:
Discover new family members and unlock old memories

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/b90c4d0ea137cc0ab2c6cbcfd3ecfb1022b2f909.png[/img]

Help Manon discover her family tree in this 2.5D point & click narrative game. Retrace the story of Manon's origin by flipping through a new notebook, paying attention to details and resolving puzzles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725360/looK_INside__Chapter_2/?l=english

notes.title: looK INside Chapter 2 is delayed to September 19th
notes.notes:
Manon has had some problem to find her family notebook, looK INside Chapter 2's launch is unfortunately delayed.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/0c8b8c114e65a0f894910d3e5537df44aed9d6b9.png[/img]

But don't worry the wait won't be too long, looK INside Chapter 2 is now launching on the 19th of September. Prepare yourself for this new chapter of generational quest and help Manon complete her family tree!

Be sure to follow and wishlist the game to get all the latest news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725360/looK_INside__Chapter_2/?l=english

notes.title: Partnership Announcement and Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Unexpected and PID Games have partnered up for the release of looK INside - Chapter 2! To give you a glimpse of the game we are participating at the June edition of the Steam Next Fest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282781/cc99926ee932766d9dd3c69f930fff9bb37a3029.png[/img]

For the occasion you can try out for the first time a demo of looK INside - Chapter 2 from today 10am PST / 7pm CET to the 20th 10am PST / 7pm CET. Don't hesitate to give any feedback to have the best game when it launches!

And most importantly, have fun helping Manon discover the life of her family!

In the meantime, if you wish to support looK INside - Chapter 2 you can wishlist and follow the game on the Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725360/looK_INside__Chapter_2/
